# Official product photography and interface screenshots

Retrieved 2026-09-22 for the SmartHome-AI educational guide. Exact original asset URLs, dimensions and local filenames are in `sources.json`. Web copies preserve the content and are resized/encoded as WebP. These are manufacturer/project examples, not photographs or private screenshots of the author's home. English labels and interface versions may differ from the reader's installation.

- ESP32-DevKitC V4: Espressif, annotated board photograph. https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-dev-kits/en/latest/esp32/esp32-devkitc/user_guide.html
- ATOM-S3: M5Stack, product photograph and feature callouts. https://docs.m5stack.com/en/core/AtomS3
- Home Assistant Voice Preview Edition and Green: Home Assistant / Nabu Casa. https://www.home-assistant.io/voice-pe/
- Frigate live view and review screens: Frigate project. https://frigate.video/
- ESPHome Device Builder: ESPHome documentation. https://esphome.io/install/getting-started/
- Reolink RLC-810A: Reolink, product photograph. https://reolink.com/product/rlc-810a/

The homepage also reuses the Philips Hue Liane photograph from `../devices/hue-liane-2026.jpg`, credited to Signify / Philips Hue in `docs-assets.md`.

Product names, photographs and marks belong to their respective owners; this project's code license does not apply to them. Source pages are linked with each illustration. The Home Assistant screenshots reused from `../ha-guide/` retain their existing credits and licensing information.
